name: novel-studio
description: PiNovelStudio - Writer's Room multi-agent novel generation extension

scripts.clean: node scripts/artifact-operation-lock.mjs --command "node scripts/clean-dirs.mjs dist dist-eval dist-test"
scripts.build: node scripts/artifact-operation-lock.mjs --command "node scripts/generate-build-info.mjs && node scripts/clean-dirs.mjs dist dist-eval dist-test && npx tsc -p tsconfig.prod.json && npx tsc -p tsconfig.eval.json && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json"
scripts.build:prod: node scripts/artifact-operation-lock.mjs --command "node scripts/generate-build-info.mjs && node scripts/clean-dirs.mjs dist && npx tsc -p tsconfig.prod.json"
scripts.build:eval: node scripts/artifact-operation-lock.mjs --command "node scripts/clean-dirs.mjs dist-eval && npx tsc -p tsconfig.eval.json"
scripts.build:test: node scripts/artifact-operation-lock.mjs --command "node scripts/generate-build-info.mjs && node scripts/clean-dirs.mjs dist-test && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json"
scripts.test:fresh: node scripts/artifact-operation-lock.mjs --command "npm run build && node --import ./tests/setup-test-env.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify:prompt-registry: node scripts/artifact-operation-lock.mjs --command "npm run build:eval && node scripts/prompt-registry-drift-check.mjs && node --import ./tests/setup-test-env.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/phase9-registry-governance.test.mjs && node --import ./tests/setup-test-env.mjs --test tests/phase5-unified-default-path.test.mjs"
